data.one_liner: Offline Bangladesh geographic dataset with bilingual search and lookup utilities.
data.what_it_does: Provides const Dart objects for all Bangladesh administrative units (Divisions, Districts, Upazilas, Unions, Post Offices). Includes synchronous ID lookup, hierarchical navigation, bilingual/legacy‑spelling search, postcode validation, address formatting and distance calculations.
use_when: Need Bangladesh location data without network calls
Require fast, zero‑dependency lookups for addresses or postal codes
Building forms or validators that need Bangladeshi administrative hierarchy
avoid_when: Need worldwide or dynamic geographic data
Require map tiles or live geofencing
Dataset must be updated frequently from a remote source
strengths: Bilingual (English & Bengali) names and legacy spelling support
Full hierarchical navigation and address formatting
